ambiguities_declared: The controlled relation vocabulary has no category for a reporting deadline; the 10-day quarterly reporting deadline (P[1]) is captured only as a quote, not as a classified claim.
The controlled relation vocabulary has no category for a recordkeeping/retention obligation; the subpart V record retention requirement (P[14]) is captured only as a quote, not as a classified claim.
P[8] references 'the number of source water TOC samples taken each month,' implying a monthly TOC monitoring frequency, but this section does not itself state that frequency requirement.
'Operational evaluation levels' are referenced as a reporting trigger in P[6], but this section does not define the numeric threshold or calculation for an operational evaluation level.

verified_quotes.exact_text: You must report the following information for each monitoring location to the State within 10 days of the end of any quarter in which monitoring is required:

Arithmetic average of quarterly results for the last four quarters for each monitoring location (LRAA), beginning at the end of the fourth calendar quarter that follows the compliance date and at the end of each subsequent quarter.
Whether, based on § 141.64(b)(2) and this subpart, the MCL was violated at any monitoring location.
Any operational evaluation levels that were exceeded during the quarter and, if so, the location and date, and the calculated TTHM and HAA5 levels.
The running annual average (RAA) of quarterly averages from the past four quarters.
The State may choose to perform calculations and determine whether the MCL was exceeded or the system is eligible for reduced monitoring in lieu of having the system report that information
You must retain any subpart V monitoring plans and your subpart V monitoring results as required by § 141.33.
